chunks: Are they so envious of others for what God has given them of His bounty? So We had given the Book and the Law to Abraham's family, and given them great dominion.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the envy towards the Prophet's family and their divine gifts?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a refutation of the envy directed at the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt, linking their spiritual authority to the broader legacy of the Prophets. It emphasizes that the 'Book and Wisdom' granted to the family of Abraham prefigure the unique status of the Prophet Muhammad (SAW) and his progeny, establishing a continuous line of divine guidance and dominion.
